description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Pennsylvania Code (the state's administrative REGULATIONS, not the Consolidated Statutes) by citation, e.g. "25 Pa. Code § 105.13" or "55 Pa. Code § 3270.1". Returns the current text with subsection structure, the Authority and Source notes, and the date through which the Code is current. Pass `citation` ("25 Pa. Code § 105.13") or `title` + `section`. Optional `subsection` (e.g. "d") returns just that subsection. Keyless.

citation.description: Full citation, e.g. "25 Pa. Code § 105.13" or "55 Pa. Code 3270.1". Alternative to title + section.

section.description: Section number as cited, e.g. "105.13" or "3270.1". The part before the dot is the chapter.

subsection.description: Optional lettered subsection to return alone, e.g. "d" or "(d)".

title.description: Pennsylvania Code title number, e.g. "25" (Environmental Protection), "55" (Human Services), "52" (Public Utilities).

name: pa_code_section
title: Pa Code Section
